visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a pair of hands holding two eyeshadow palettes against a plain white background. On the left is a dark Tom Ford palette, and on the right is a silver Visee palette. Both are open, revealing four shades of shimmering powder. (2) The scene cuts to a woman with full makeup and elegant star earrings holding the two palettes beside her face. She looks confidently at the camera while moving the products slightly. (3) Hands hold two slender lipsticks: a black M.A.C stick and a grey essence stick. Both caps are removed to show the reddish-brown lipstick shades. (4) The woman is shown again, now holding the two lipsticks close to her lips, demonstrating the color comparison. She has a neutral, slight smile. (5) Hands hold two blush compacts: a gold SUQQU palette with a gradient pink powder and a smaller clear essence blush with a muted rose tone. Brushes are included in both. (6) The woman holds the two blush palettes on either side of her cheeks, looking directly at the viewer. (7) Hands display two tubes of face product: a dark blue Clé de Peau Beauté tube and a light beige EXCEL tube. (8) The woman holds these two products near her face, maintaining the same presentation style. (9) Hands hold two concealer containers: a black DIOR bottle with a wand and a light pink TIRTIR dual-ended concealer. (10) The final shot shows the woman holding the concealers near her eyes, smiling brightly as the video ends.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with styled dark hair, wearing star-shaped earrings and a grey ribbed sweater. She has meticulously applied makeup matching the products shown.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, slightly blurred indoor background with white walls and a shelf containing various containers and bottles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic music begins with a heavy drum beat and bright synth tones. A female singer performs upbeat lyrics. A sharp 'hit' SFX punctuates the first scene cut. (2) Music continues with consistent BPM and rhythmic intensity. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effects accompanies the transition to the woman's face. (3) The rhythmic pattern repeats. Another percussive hit SFX marks the cut to the lipstick comparison. (4) Energy remains high. The interplay between the driving bassline and the vocal track is prominent. Transition SFX occurs at the cut. (5) Fast-paced editing is mirrored in the audio with a percussive impact at every visual switch. The music maintain its major-mode, happy vibe. (6) Continued upbeat pop/EDM track. Vocal delivery is rhythmic and energetic. Impact SFX at the cut. (7) Consistent sound design with an impact sound every 1.5 seconds, matching the visual montage of skin products. (8) The music loop continues smoothly. The female vocal line ascends in pitch slightly. Transition noise at the cut. (9) Heavy beat and crisp percussion dominate the mix. Final impact SFX as the concealers are shown. (10) Music fades out abruptly at the end of the 14-second clip after a final vocal phrase.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Comparison 1 -> Comparison 2 -> Comparison 3 -> Comparison 4 -> Comparison 5
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase affordable alternatives (dupes) for luxury makeup brands, providing viewers with high-value product comparisons in a rapid, visually engaging format.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While brands are shown, the format is a comparison review rather than a paid promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a highly effective rhythm-matching technique between the visual cuts and the background music's percussive hits, enhancing the 'list' feel.
